messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired -> metrics-pipeline: consumer lag on topic 'metrics-raw' exceeded 1,000,000 messages; log-ingest backlog growing :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident PD-78923 created and routed to oncall (eng-sre)
matt.s: acked. I'm on it — starting triage. tagging @sara.t and @devon
sara.t: on call ramp-up, grabbing prometheus and kafka dashboards now. any customer-visible errors reported?
devon: not seeing 5xx spikes in frontend, but internal async features (realtime-metrics) may see delays. customers could see stale dashboards.
matt.s: first pri checks:
```
# prometheus targets for telemetry namespace
kubectl -n telemetry exec -it prometheus-0 -- curl -sS localhost:9090/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | select(.discoveredLabels.job=="scrape-targets") | {target: .discoveredLabels.__address__, state: .health}'
```
log snippet -> several "context deadline exceeded" and "write tcp: connection reset by peer" on /metrics endpoints
sara.t: I can see scrape flapping for a couple services: svc-a:9100 and svc-b:9100. frequency increased after recent canary rollout at ~01:20 UTC.
matt.s: interesting — if scrapes fail we fall back to fewer metrics which can trigger downstream aggregators to stall. checking Thanos sidecar queue and remote_write errors
monitoring-bot: Thanos sidecar: remote_write errors rate 120/min, ingestion buffer pressure 85%
devon: also seeing a consumer group rebalance on kafka group 'metrics-ingest-consumers' around the same time. partitions assigned/unassigned rapidly -> consumer lag builds up
lia (oncall): switching to runbook mode. Assigning roles: matt = prometheus/targets, sara = kafka/consumers, devon = sidecar/remote_write. lia = customer comms + paging updates
eng-manager: please escalate if >30m with customer impact, I'll join call
sara.t: kafka consumer logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-14T01:28:15Z consumer[3]: rebalance in progress, reason: new member joined
2026-03-14T01:29:01Z consumer[3]: failed to fetch messages: RetriableException - connection reset
2026-03-14T01:30:05Z consumer[3]: processed 0 msgs in last 60s
```
lia (oncall): customer-impact assessment: dashboards refresh delayed for some customers, alerting still working. No broad API error yet. marking SEV2-> but PagerDuty flagged P1 due to backlog growth and potential data loss risk
matt.s: mitigation plan:
- rollback canary for svc-a/svc-b to reduce scrape churn (rollback in progress)
- temporarily pause Thanos remote_write to drain sidecar buffer more predictably (will increase short-term disk buffer)
- scale up metrics-ingest-consumer replicas by +2 to catch up backlog
sara.t: scaling consumers now: `kubectl -n telemetry scale deploy metrics-ingest-consumers --replicas=6`
devon: pausing remote_write via config toggle in telemetry-configmap, applying now. watch sidecar buffers
monitoring-bot: scaling event detected for metrics-ingest-consumers -> desired=6 current=3
matt.s: good. Post-mitigation checks: watch consumer lag (kafka.consumer_lag), sidecar buffer, prometheus target health
lia (oncall): PagerDuty update: PD-78923 acknowledged by matt.s, ack at 01:36 UTC. Notified product ops and support to prepare customer comms if lag persists
sara.t: consumers are catching up, lag dropping from 1,100,000 -> 420,000 in 10m. Thanos buffer dropping from 85% -> 40% after pausing remote_write (expected, disk retention increased)
matt.s: svc-a and svc-b rollback completed at 01:44 UTC, target flapping reduced. Prometheus target health now mostly UP
devon: re-enable remote_write only after consumers reach stable lag <50k and sidecar buffer <20%
lia (oncall): i'll keep paging open for 45m for monitoring and handoff. If stable, we'll close PD and write a short incident note
eng-manager: thanks team. schedule postmortem tomorrow EOD if we see regression or customer complaints
sara.t: noted. will collect logs and timelines for postmortem. adding links to dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/metrics-pipeline
matt.s: closing notes: root cause appears to be canary rollout causing scrape jitter + upstream network errors => triggered consumer rebalances; combined with Thanos remote_write backpressure led to backlog amplification. Follow-up: add circuit-breaker to remote_write and tighter canary ramp controls for telemetry targets :thumbsup:
lia (oncall): PD-78923 -> will move to resolved in 45m if metrics continue steady. thanks all :raised_hands:
